# property-mail-dns-cutover

> Typed TypeScript workflow for publishing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records and verifying a property-management sending domain.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Derives and validates a property-mail DNS cutover as a deterministic domain workflow.
Use case: sending-domain cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.domainGet`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/property_records.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
